verdict.rationale: The public supabase/auth GitHub repository documents server-side configuration behavior, such as disabling signups, password rules and refresh-token rotation. This suggests the Auth server is source-available and can be run and configured by the operator. No evidence item explicitly describes self-hosting, deployment instructions or licensing, so support is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting documentation, deployment/setup guide, open-source license confirmation, parity notes between hosted and self-hosted, hands-on self-hosting reports.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: When signup is disabled the only way to create new users is through invites.
Use this to disable email signups (users can still use external OAuth providers to sign up / sign in)
If refresh token rotation is enabled, auth will automatically detect malicious attempts to reuse a revoked refresh token.
